requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB) or NCLC 4 in listening, reading, writing and speaking; required by all three Skilled Worker pathways (New Brunswick Experience, New Brunswick Graduates, New Brunswick Priority Occupations)

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Experience pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You must already have at least 6 months of full-time work experience with the supporting employer

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Experience pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You must have been living in New Brunswick with valid temporary resident status for the past 6 months

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream (Experience / Graduates / Priority Occupations)
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: At least 19 years old

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream (Experience / Graduates / Priority Occupations)
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.valueText: have the support of an eligible employer who has been actively operating in New Brunswick for the past 24 months
requirements.label: Supporting employer actively operating in New Brunswick for the past 24 months

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream (Experience / Graduates / Priority Occupations)
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: meet your New Brunswick job requirements, according to the National Occupational Classification and other applicable laws and regulations
requirements.label: Meet the job requirements under the NOC and applicable laws

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Experience pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be working full time in a non-seasonal position for the employer who is supporting your application
requirements.label: Working full-time in a non-seasonal position for the supporting employer
requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Experience

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Experience pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have at least a high school diploma

requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Experience

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Graduates pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have completed a program of study that is eligible for a post-graduation work permit at a designated learning institution located in New Brunswick
requirements.label: Completed a PGWP-eligible program at a New Brunswick designated learning institution
requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Graduates

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Graduates pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be working in, or have accepted, a full time non-seasonal position for the employer who is supporting your application
requirements.label: Working in or accepted a full-time non-seasonal position with the supporting employer
requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Graduates

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Priority Occupations pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have accepted a full-time, non-seasonal job offer from the employer who is supporting your application
requirements.label: Accepted a full-time, non-seasonal job offer from the supporting employer
requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Priority Occupations

requirements.stream: New Brunswick Skilled Worker stream — New Brunswick Priority Occupations pathway
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have at least a high school diploma

requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Priority Occupations

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: the offer must be a direct result of a recruitment mission led by the Government of New Brunswick

requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Priority Occupations

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: the National Occupational Classification for the position must be one of the priority codes specified in the guide

requirements.section: Skilled Worker stream page — New Brunswick Priority Occupations

requirements.subject: applicant
